history.description: Increased range of the Geared-Up Archer Tower from 7 tiles to 8 tiles.

facts: Archer Towers are single-target defenses in the Home Village. They are the second defense available to players and the first defense to attack aerial troops, unlocked at Town Hall 2.
At Town Hall 16, two level 21 Archer Towers that are not geared up can be merged to form a Multi-Archer Tower.
